content_fields.title: Verify that only approved cryptographic algorithms and key lengths are used
content_fields.description: Use an approved algorithm with a key of adequate length, supplied externally.
content_fields.finding: HS256 is used with a key that defaults to six decimal digits, far below any approved key-length requirement.
criteria: The signing key is at least 256 bits.
The algorithm is an approved one and is pinned at both signing and verification.
Startup fails when the key is too short or missing.
